etsy.description:
A programmer humor poster for the official fix to every lint warning: eslint-disable-next-line, in dark-mode colors.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you

HOW TO USE

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: No ESLint or linter humor prints surfaced on Etsy; the niche is open but has no indexed phrase of its own.
Programmer humor results are dominated by shirts ('not a bug, undocumented feature', 'don't deploy on Friday').
Amazon programmer prints lead with the joke, then stack 'wall art', 'office decor', 'developer gift' and state 'unframed' plus size.
No linter-themed posters seen on Amazon either.

research.notes: No search phrase for ESLint posters was found, so the primary keyword is the broader indexed 'programmer humor', with ESLint (printed on the poster) kept in title and tags. Dropped 'React' from the old title and description: it is not on the poster. Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with framed prints, and no unframed physical prints with prices were comparable.
